message.materia.amphora.beer_mash_need_w: Fill the amphora with water to start a mash
message.materia.amphora.beer_mash_hint: Add 4 wheat and 1 hops to make beer mash
jei.materia.coal_coke_fuels_only: Fuel: coal coke. Charcoal and vanilla coal cannot run this recipe.
jei.materia.bellows_fuels_heavy_solids_o: Bellows recipe: fuel must be charcoal, coal, coke (or pitch/tar/redstone fuel)—not planks, sticks, or saplings.
jei.materia.coke_oven.fuel_slot: Heat (separate slot): vanilla coal or charcoal. This is burned in addition to the coal being coked.
jei.materia.rice: Rice only grows when water is within 2 blocks. Harvest yields rice in the hull; shell in a crafting grid, then boil in a water pot for cooked rice.
jei.materia.cotton: White cotton dyes like wool. Spin 2 cotton (or colored cotton) on a spinning wheel into string.
jei.materia.tea_bush: Right-click a fully grown tea bush to harvest tea leaves; it regrows one stage younger.
jei.materia.taro: Raw taro is mildly poisonous. Boil in a water pot over a campfire or bake in an oven for cooked taro.
jei.materia.spinning_wheel: Use with 2 cotton, wool, or colored cotton in hand: yields 2 string (10% chance of 3).
message.materia.amphora.tea_steeped: The water has steeped into tea
advancements.materia.root.title: Materia
advancements.materia.root.description: Survival reworked—from knapped stones to furnaces worthy of empire.
advancements.materia.the_secret.title: The Secret
advancements.materia.the_secret.descript: "The secret is to bang the rocks together, guys!"—hammer stone acquired.
advancements.materia.next_circuses.title: Next: Circuses
advancements.materia.next_circuses.descr: Bread rises. Grain work has begun.
advancements.materia.pointed_stick.title: Pointed Stick
advancements.materia.pointed_stick.descr: Fashion a spear. Distance is dignity.
advancements.materia.sticky_business.des: Harvest latex—for rubber goods and treeblood pride.
advancements.materia.the_neolithic.title: The Neolithic Age
advancements.materia.the_neolithic.descr: Build a primitive crafting table—a fixed workspace for the grind ahead.
advancements.materia.ring_of_truth.title: Ring of Truth
advancements.materia.ring_of_truth.descr: Place a stone anvil. Metal finally has somewhere honest to strike.
advancements.materia.controlled_burn.des: Raise a fire pit—the hearth route to tongs, cooking, and hot work.
advancements.materia.trial_by_fire.title: Trial by Fire
advancements.materia.trial_by_fire.descr: Build a kiln. Quicklime calls; ore gets serious heat.
advancements.materia.handle_with_care.de: Fashion wood tongs so the fire stops eating your fingerprints.
advancements.materia.speedy_citrus.title: Speedy Citrus
advancements.materia.speedy_citrus.descr: Produce quicklime. Not lemonade—much angrier limestone.
advancements.materia.the_bronze_age.desc: Produce a bronze ingot. Alloy work unlocks sharper tools—and harsher taxes.
advancements.materia.depth_of_boiling.de: Acquire a water pot—a cavernous boil for bones, bark, and bulk prep.
advancements.materia.jar_theology.title: Jar Theology
advancements.materia.jar_theology.descri: Own an amphora for bulk ferment and slow clock recipes.
advancements.materia.between_the_laths.d: Wattle and daub—mud between sticks, hardened into home.
advancements.materia.exclusive_purples.t: Now You Know Why It Was So Expensive
advancements.materia.exclusive_purples.d: Stock Tyrian-tier story dyes—purple lines fit for stingy senators.
advancements.materia.under_the_warp.desc: Build or hold a frame loom—eight strands at once to carpet civilization.
advancements.materia.pack_rat_royalty.de: Sew any dyed Materia sack. Portable pantry, dubious posture.
advancements.materia.lattice_logistics.d: Weave a basket—wicker storage for burdens and barter.
advancements.materia.sister_act.title: Sister Act
advancements.materia.sister_act.descript: Harvest mature Three Sisters bounty—corn cob, squash, and dry beans.
advancements.materia.cotton_pickings.des: Harvest cotton bolls from the field. Spin them into string on a spindle or spinning wheel.
advancements.materia.rainbow_grove.title: Rainbow Grove
advancements.materia.rainbow_grove.descr: Find a rainbow eucalyptus—striped bark in an ordinary grove.
advancements.materia.full_spectrum.title: Full Spectrum
advancements.materia.full_spectrum.descr: Collect every Materia dye—from verdigris and indigo to burgundy and tan.
advancements.materia.arts_and_crafts.des: Earn the vanilla crafting table after bronze—with a water pot in hand.
advancements.materia.the_iron_age.title: The Iron Age
advancements.materia.the_iron_age.descri: Wrought iron blooms—or erect an iron anvil when brute force suffices.
advancements.materia.wings_of_empire.des: Stand up an Aquila Aurea—a gilded standard for bronze-age boasting.
advancements.materia.cooked_carbon.title: Cooked Carbon
advancements.materia.cooked_carbon.descr: Industrial char—coal coke in pocket or bricks for a full coke oven.
advancements.materia.stacked_heat.title: Stacked Heat
advancements.materia.stacked_heat.descri: Line up chimney, furnace kiln, or blast furnace kiln—anything that counts as unbearably tall heat.
advancements.materia.carbon_temper.title: Carbon Temper
advancements.materia.carbon_temper.descr: Finish the steel storyline—hold the ingot Materia treats as steel (steel tools still read as vanilla iron ingots elsewhere).
advancements.materia.beer_is_good.title: Beer Is Good
advancements.materia.beer_is_good.descri: Bottle Materia beer. Air is okay; barley solutions are louder.
advancements.materia.in_vino_veritas.des: Bottle Materia wine. Truth optional; tannins mandatory.
advancements.materia.breach_loader.title: Breach Loader
advancements.materia.breach_loader.descr: Deploy or carry a siege cannon—assemble the boom-stick culture.
advancements.materia.roundshot_ringer.de: Score any kill where the cannonball projectile deals the lethal blow.
advancements.materia.stored_energy.title: Stored Energy
advancements.materia.stored_energy.descr: String a composite bow—layered horns, disciplined violence.
